description: Plan captions to a published standard (netflix_adult, netflix_kids, bbc, dcmp, social_9x16) from a transcript (word_timeline, text or file; SRT, VTT, ElevenLabs Scribe or Premiere transcript JSON): chunking, line breaks, timing, gaps, speakers, SDH. Optionally writes the plan JSON and an SRT/VTT/TTML file. cut_times come from detect_scene_edits / scene_edit_detection or sequence edit points. Local-only; never changes Premiere.

accessibility.description: Never use colour as the only cue: with speaker_style color, a label is added at each speaker change too. Default false.

approved_workspace_path.description: Absolute path of an existing directory the caller approved for file access. transcript_path, plan_path and output paths must be inside it.

cleanup.description: Transcript clean-up before captions are made. The result's `cleanup` counts what changed.

case.description: Case of the caption text. Default as_is.

drop_after_s.description: Drop words that start at or after this time (seconds, transcript time): speech recognition often invents words in trailing silence or music. Give the audio's end.

drop_music_tokens.description: Drop words that are only music notes, the replacement character or other symbol-only tokens. Default true.

filler_words.description: Your own filler list instead of the default.

glossary.description: Whole-word find and replace, in order (brand names, spellings the transcript gets wrong). A phrase may span words.

replace.description: Replacement text; empty removes the match.

min_word_s.description: Drop words shorter than this (seconds); recognisers leave near-zero spans where they guessed. Default 0.05; 0 keeps all.

remove_fillers.description: Remove filler words (um, uh, erm, er, ah, hmm, mm, mhm). Default false.

remove_stutters.description: Collapse stutters and repeats ('I- I', 'the the', 'the, the') into one word. Default false.

strip_punctuation.description: Remove punctuation from the caption text (apostrophes inside words stay). Sentence ends are still used for grouping. Default false.

close_gaps_under.description: Seconds: a gap shorter than this (and longer than the minimum) closes to min_gap_frames. Default the standard's (0.5 s), else off.

cut_times.description: Shot changes in sequence seconds (not source time). Get them from detect_scene_edits / scene_edit_detection or from the sequence's edit points. Captions do not straddle a cut: an in-time moves onto the cut or at least 0.5 s before it, an out-time to 2 frames before it or at least 0.5 s after.

end_s.description: Where the sequence (or media) ends, in sequence seconds (after offset). No caption ends past it, a caption that would start at or after it is dropped, and a sound or linger extension never passes it; each is listed in changes with rule sequence_end. A transcript that states its media duration (Whisper, ElevenLabs) also clamps to that duration plus offset. create_caption_track import_plan and add_caption_graphics clamp to the sequence's own end.

expected_cep_target.description: Optional reviewed CEP sequence/clip identity and exact tick ranges. Checked before every generated command; UXP refuses this CEP-only guard.

effect.description: Reviewed effect and parameter identity checked before mutation.

match_name.description: Effect match name from host inspection.

end_ticks.description: Exact expected exclusive timeline end ticks.

out_ticks.description: Exact expected exclusive source Out ticks.

track_index.description: Expected zero-based track index; identity still checked.

project_document_id.description: Exact Premiere project document ID observed during review.

source_item.description: Reviewed source identity for a source-only operation.

expected_project_path.description: Optional absolute saved-project path. Every generated CEP command refuses before its body when the active project differs or is unsaved. UXP commands refuse this CEP-only guard; local-only tools do not inspect Premiere. Omit to keep existing behavior.

export.description: Also write the captions as a sidecar file: SRT, WebVTT or TTML (IMSC text profile). Omit output_path to get the text back inline (up to 512 KiB). The written file is read back to confirm the cue count.

format.description: File format: srt, vtt or ttml.

lang.description: ttml only: language tag of the document, for example en or en-GB.

line_pct.description: vtt and ttml: where the top of the text sits, percent of the frame height.

output_path.description: Absolute path of a new file inside approved_workspace_path. Never overwrites. Extension must match: .srt, .vtt, or .ttml / .xml.

region_width_pct.description: vtt and ttml: width of the text box, percent of the frame width.

speaker_voice.description: vtt only: write speakers as <v Name> voice spans (default true when the plan has speakers).

fix.description: With a standard: fix what breaks it (default true). false only reports violations.

frame_rate.description: Frames per second of the sequence; every caption time is rounded to whole frames of this rate. Premiere sequences report it (or convert Sequence timebase ticks with 254016000000 ticks per second). Default 30, with a warning.

from_s.description: Only transcript words that overlap this time and later (before offset). A word or cue that straddles the bound is clipped, not dropped. Use the clip in-point (transcribe_audio audible_source_range) or a long transcript captioned in several calls.

highlight_lead_frames.description: The highlighted word switches this many frames before the voice (reads as in sync). Default 1.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-chosen key (1-128 chars of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -) for this intended edit. Pass a fresh key per edit and reuse it only when retrying that same edit, for example after a client-side timeout. A repeat with the same tool, key and arguments is not run again: while the first call is running it fails with IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS (poll get_last_operations); after it finished it returns the original outcome marked replayed. A definite failure with nothing applied (receipt outcome not_applied) may be retried with the same key. Reusing a key with different arguments fails with IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. Scoped to this MCP session (the stdio server process, or the HTTP server process when Streamable HTTP is stateless per request) and held in memory only (200 keys, 1 hour); it does not survive a restart or reconnect. Read-only invocations are never deduplicated.

linger.description: Seconds a caption stays after its last word (up to the next caption), default 0.25.

max_chars_per_line.description: Characters per line, default 32 (about 20 suits 9:16). Counted, not measured: a proportional font can run wider.

max_duration.description: A caption is split when it would run longer than this, default 6.

max_lines.description: Lines per caption, default 2. A caption is split when its words would need more.

max_words.description: Words per caption at most (social chunking).

min_duration.description: Seconds a caption stays up at least (up to the next caption), default 1.

min_gap_frames.description: Frames between captions at least. Default 2 with a standard, else 0.

offset.description: Seconds added to every transcript time, for example the clip's start on the sequence (captions must not start before 0).

pause_break.description: A pause between words longer than this starts a new caption, default 0.7.

plan_output_path.description: Absolute .json path of a new file inside approved_workspace_path to save the plan document to (never overwrites). Host tools (create_caption_track action import_plan, add_caption_graphics) take it as plan_path. Required when the plan is too big to return inline (above 500 captions or 256 KiB) unless export.output_path is set.

sdh.description: Subtitles for the deaf and hard of hearing: sound events and lyrics.

lyric_ranges.description: Sung passages (transcript time): their captions are marked lyric (italic, wrapped in music notes).

end.description: End of the sung passage in transcript seconds; must be after start.

start.description: Start of the sung passage in transcript seconds.

sound_events.description: Keep sound events (ElevenLabs audio_event entries, or words in square brackets) as their own captions in [lower-case brackets]. Default true.

sequence_timebase_ticks.description: Premiere ticks per frame of the sequence (the timebase from get_sequence_settings; 254016000000 ticks make a second). Converted to a frame rate with the common rates snapped (23.976, 25, 29.97 ...). An error when frame_rate is also given and differs.

single_word.description: One word per caption (social style): a word shorter than 8 frames merges into the next, and a number with its unit or a first name with a surname stays together.

speaker_colors.description: Colours (#RRGGBB) per speaker in order of first appearance instead of the BBC order.

speaker_names.description: Display names for speaker ids (e.g. {"speaker_0": "ANNA"}), for labels.

speaker_style.description: How a speaker change shows: color (BBC order white, yellow, cyan, green per speaker), hyphen (two speakers in one caption, each line starting '- '), label ('NAME: ' at each change). Default none.

standard.description: A caption standard: netflix_adult (20 cps, 42 cpl, 2 lines, 5/6 s to 7 s, 2-frame gaps), netflix_kids (17 cps), bbc (180 wpm, 0.33 s per word, 37 cpl), dcmp (32 cpl, 40 frames to 6 s), social_9x16 (25 cpl, 3 lines). Sets the defaults for line length, lines, durations, gaps and linger (explicit fields still win) and turns on fixing: out-times extend into the gap, then short captions merge, then long ones split. The result lists every change and any violation left.

to_s.description: Only transcript words that overlap times before this (before offset). A word or cue that straddles the bound is clipped, not dropped. Use the clip out-point so captions do not land on later shots.

transcript_format.description: Format of transcript_text or transcript_path. Default: from the file extension, else from the content.

transcript_path.description: Absolute path of a .srt, .vtt or .json transcript inside approved_workspace_path (realpath-checked, at most 16 MiB). Requires approved_workspace_path.

transcript_text.description: The transcript itself (SRT, WebVTT, or JSON: ElevenLabs Scribe, Whisper-style segments, a plain array of {text,start,end}, or Premiere's exported transcript JSON), instead of word_timeline or transcript_path. At most 16 MiB.

word_timeline.description: Caller-supplied word-timed transcript for one Premiere source item. Words must be ordered by start time and bound to the transcript revision returned by get_clip_transcript_uxp. Different labeled speakers may overlap; same-speaker words may not, even when another speaker is between them.

words.description: Ordered word tokens with source-time boundaries.

name: plan_captions

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true; on failure, diagnostic detail when the tool provides it.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

idempotency.description: Present when idempotency_key deduplicated this call: replayed is true when the original outcome was returned instead of running again.

receipt.description: Versioned common mutation receipt; success never implies rendered verification.

title: Plan Captions
